name: Tracy Reed
bio: Tracy Reed (born October 28, 1949) is an American retired actress and former model. She first appeared and co-starred in the 1970 TV series Barefoot in the Park and played Virginia Tyndall in the 1979 TV mini-series Women in White. Her most memorable film roles include No Way Back (1976), Car Wash (1976), A Piece of the Action (1977), ...All the Marbles (1981) and Running Scared (1986).
